text:
Maya: quick sync — need to lock the runtime telemetry contract so product can start wiring the token-cost dashboard (cost per 1K tokens + cache/batch savings). who's available?
Phil: I can do a first pass on the dashboard mock. need the metrics shape though — counts vs percentiles?
Dina: for routing/quota decisions we need labels: model, deployment_variant, region, route_tag (e.g., safe_fallback). also per-request tokens_in / tokens_out.
Ravi: agree on labels. runtime should emit: `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `kv_cache_hits`, `kv_cache_lookups`, `batch_size_histogram`, `request_route`.
Sam: for cost calc we'll join `tokens_out` * model_unit_cost + batching_savings. need a consistent unit: per 1000 output tokens.
Maya: perfect. product wants both absolute $/1k and % savings breakdown (cache vs batching). UX wants a stacked bar by route_tag and a line for 1k cost trend.
Phil: can the runtime add `kv_cache_hit_rate` as a derived metric? or should we compute it in telemetry by `kv_cache_hits / kv_cache_lookups`?
Ravi: compute in the metrics backend (don't add dup metrics). emit raw counters only.
Dina: tagging note — quota enforcement path needs `quota_decision` label (`allowed`, `throttled`, `rate_limited`) so the dashboard can show cost impact of throttles.
Sam: here's a rough PromQL prototype for the $/1k calc (needs model_unit_cost join table):
```
(sum(rate(tokens_out[5m])) by (model) * on(model) group_left(model_unit_cost) (model_unit_cost)) / (sum(rate(tokens_out[5m])) by (model) / 1000)
```
Maya: nice. we should standardize metric names now: `redwood.tokens_out`, `redwood.tokens_in`, `redwood.kv_cache_hits`, `redwood.kv_cache_lookups`, `redwood.batch_size`.
infra-bot: new ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-3224 — "telemetry: econ metrics contract + labels" assigned to Ravi.
Ravi: I'll open the proto PR today with the labels + units. ETA EOD. I'll include an example event and the expected PromQL joins.
Phil: i'll mock the console panels by tomorrow and link to the ticket. Dina/Sam can review for routing/quota use cases.
Dina: will validate quota labels against enforcement codepath. code owner: @dina.
Sam: I'll draft the save/cost aggregation SQL to power the breakdown tile.
Maya: next steps: Ravi proto PR -> infra ticket -> Phil mock -> Sam SQL -> handoff to console. thanks all. :thumbsup:
